categories.name: Target Hardware & Demonstration Build
categories.description: Covers the supported STM32 target, motor-driver board, motor and power setup, plus build, flashing, and demonstration deliverables.
requirements: The delivered firmware shall run on the NUCLEO-G431RB with the X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 and automatically demonstrate basic rotation of the GBM2804H-100T three-phase gimbal motor after power-up.
The firmware shall build successfully and be flashable to the target hardware.
The target MCU board for the firmware shall be the NUCLEO-G431RB.
The motor driver board used shall be the X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 (STSPIN830).
The motor used for the demonstration shall be the GBM2804H-100T with 7 pole pairs.
The test setup shall provide a 12 V DC supply.

categories.name: PWM Timer & Motor-Driver Interface
categories.description: Covers TIM1 three-phase PWM generation, U/V/W output routing, driver input configuration, PWM carrier settings, and safe initialization before driver enable.
requirements: The firmware shall configure TIM1 to generate three-phase PWM.
The firmware shall use the factory-default X-NUCLEO-IHM16M1 three-input configuration.
The firmware shall drive the U, V, and W three-phase motor outputs.
The PWM switching frequency shall be 20 kHz.
The firmware shall complete TIM1 and PWM GPIO configuration with PWM outputs disabled before asserting the motor driver enable at the start of the sequence.

categories.name: Open-Loop Sinusoidal Motor Control
categories.description: Covers the open-loop rotating electrical field, frequency and amplitude ramps, PWM amplitude limits, smooth control updates, and visible motor motion.
requirements: The firmware shall generate a rotating three-phase electrical field using open-loop sinusoidal PWM.
The firmware shall ramp PWM amplitude gradually to avoid an abrupt startup.
Between 3 s and 8 s from boot, the firmware shall ramp electrical frequency from 1 Hz to 10 Hz.
Between 3 s and 8 s from boot, the firmware shall ramp PWM amplitude from 10% to 20%.
Between 8 s and 18 s from boot, the firmware shall hold the electrical frequency at 10 Hz.
Between 8 s and 18 s from boot, the firmware shall limit PWM amplitude to a maximum of 20%.

During the 3–8 s startup ramp, the firmware shall ramp electrical frequency smoothly from 1 Hz to 10 Hz with monotonic increase and with steps no greater than 1 Hz between consecutive control updates.
The initial PWM amplitude at the start of the startup ramp shall be 10%.
The maximum PWM amplitude during the demo shall be 20%.
Visible motor movement or rotation shall occur during the automatic run window.

categories.name: Automatic Demonstration Sequencer
categories.description: Covers boot delay, driver enable timing, demonstration run duration, hold interval, shutdown ramp, automatic PWM shutdown, standby transition, and post-run stopped state.
requirements: The motor sequence shall start automatically after the configured boot delay without any UART input.
The firmware shall run the motor for the configured demonstration duration.
At 3 s from boot, the firmware shall enable the motor driver to begin the automatic sequence.
Between 18 s and 20 s from boot, the firmware shall ramp electrical frequency down to zero.
Between 18 s and 20 s from boot, the firmware shall ramp PWM amplitude down to zero.
After 20 s from boot, the firmware shall disable PWM automatically.
After 20 s from boot, the firmware shall place the motor driver in standby automatically.
After the automatic test completes, the motor shall remain stopped until the board is reset or power-cycled.
The boot delay before starting the sequence shall be 3 seconds.
The startup ramp duration shall be 5 seconds.
The hold duration at 10 Hz and up to 20% PWM shall be 10 seconds.
The shutdown ramp duration shall be 2 seconds.

categories.name: Fault Handling, Watchdog & Reset Safety
categories.description: Covers immediate response to STSPIN830 faults, watchdog recovery, reset-safe startup behavior, and prevention of automatic restart after faults.
requirements: An active STSPIN830 EN/FAULT condition shall immediately disable PWM at any time.
The firmware shall enable a hardware watchdog such that, if the control task becomes unresponsive during the automatic sequence, the MCU resets and returns the system to the boot safe state.
Following detection of an active STSPIN830 EN/FAULT condition, the firmware shall not attempt to re-enable the motor driver or PWM automatically; recovery shall require a reset or power-cycle.
On any MCU reset event (including initial boot), the firmware shall keep PWM disabled and the motor driver in standby for the first 3 seconds before any enable action may occur.

categories.name: Control Scope & Architecture Boundaries
categories.description: Defines the intentionally minimal open-loop architecture, automatic-sequence dependencies, prohibited sensing and closed-loop features, and the absence of UART-driven operation or motor characterization.
requirements: The project scope shall be limited to verifying the MCU, motor-driver board, PWM outputs, and motor connections.
The firmware shall not implement sensorless field-oriented control (FOC).
The firmware shall not implement a rotor observer.
The firmware shall not implement Clarke or Park transforms.
The firmware shall not implement current PI or speed PI control.
The firmware shall not perform phase-current ADC control.
The firmware shall not perform VBUS ADC control.
The firmware shall not use ADC-triggered DMA.
The firmware shall not perform current-offset calibration.
The firmware shall not include oscilloscope integration.
The test shall not measure actual motor RPM.
The firmware shall not implement UART-based motor start/stop, and the automatic motor sequence shall neither require nor respond to any UART input to start or stop.
The firmware and test shall not implement or perform speed/RPM regulation; no closed-loop speed control shall be present.
The firmware shall not perform motor-parameter identification or characterization (e.g., resistance, inductance, flux), whether automatic or manual.
The automatic sequence shall depend only on successful PWM/GPIO initialization, completion of the boot delay, and absence of an active STSPIN830 hardware fault.

The automatic motor sequence shall not be blocked because ADC measurements, motor electrical parameters, characterization, FOC, observer, current sensing, UART commands, or closed-loop control are unavailable.
